focus: D1 correctness - spec-kit validation engine and rule scripts

findingDetails.title: Recursive validation silently skips a numbered child that has content but neither spec.md nor description.json
findingDetails.evidence: The child loop (validate.sh:378-394) skips any [0-9][0-9][0-9]-* directory that is non-empty but has neither spec.md nor description.json, then aggregates only validated children. The exemption targets artifact-only children; the unhandled state is a phase whose spec.md and description.json are both absent while plan.md/tasks.md remain, which the parent reports as RESULT: PASSED without naming the skipped child.
findingDetails.recommendation: Narrow the skip predicate (e.g. require that the child's top level holds only artifact directories or changelog markdown) or print the skipped numbered children in the report so a parent run cannot pass over an invalid child silently.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read the recursive loop and its skip predicate end to end, then walked the spec tree for children matched by the predicate; all observed matches are artifact-only directories.
